## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `Example`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `hubspot-crm-engagements-calls-example`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **Example**.

## Step 2: Open the Add Connection palette

1. Select **Add Connection** (or the **+** icon next to the Connections section) in the low-code canvas to open the connector search palette.

## Step 3: Search for and select the HubSpot CRM Engagements Calls connector

1. <!-- manual: In the search box, enter hubspot.crm.engagements.calls to filter the connector list. -->
2. <!-- manual: Locate the Calls connector card. -->
3. <!-- manual: Select the connector card to open the connection configuration form. -->

## Step 4: Bind connection parameters to configurable variables

1. For each non-boolean field in the **Configure HubSpot CRM Engagements Calls** form, select **Open Helper Panel**, go to the **Configurables** tab, select **+ New Configurable**, enter a descriptive variable name and type, and select **Save** to auto-inject the configurable reference into the field.
2. <!-- manual: For each non-boolean field in the Configure HubSpot CRM Engagements Calls form, select Open Helper Panel, go to the Configurables tab, select + New Configurable, enter a descriptive variable name and type, and select Save to auto-inject the configurable reference into the field. -->

## Step 5: Save the HubSpot CRM Engagements Calls connection

1. Select **Save** to persist the connection.

## Step 6: Set actual values for your configurables

1. In the left panel of WSO2 Integrator, select **Configurations** (listed at the bottom of the project tree, under Data Mappers).
2. Run the shell command `.venv/bin/python tools/write_config.py --project hubspot-crm-engagements-calls-example --expect hubspotServiceUrl,hubspotToken` to set the configurable values.

## Step 7: Add an Automation entry point

1. In the left sidebar, hover over **Entry Points** and select **Add Entry Point**, or select **Add Artifact** on the Design canvas.
2. <!-- manual: hover over Entry Points -->
3. Select **Automation** in the artifact selection panel.
4. Select **Create** in the dialog to accept the default settings and add the Automation entry point to the canvas.
5. <!-- manual: add the Automation entry point to the canvas -->

## Step 8: Select and configure the post /crm/v3/engagements/calls operation

1. Select **+** (Add Step) in the automation flow between the Start and Error Handler nodes.
2. Under **Connections** in the node panel, select **hubspot.crm.engagements.calls** node to expand it and reveal all available operations.
3. Select **Create a call** (the `post /crm/v3/engagements/calls` operation) from the list, then fill in the operation fields:
